purpose: Offline native sanity checks after the ZapFast visual/settings/theme alignment; no account data or screenshots.
context: Same development desktop as the preceding Skia comparison: RX 550, Mesa 26.2.4, KDE Wayland. Sequential runs, no simultaneous compilation.
limits: One final run per theme; uncontrolled desktop scheduling. No live-account, compositor/input latency, media, cross-platform or full-history traversal claim.
